Subject: Customer Spotlight: Priory Health — brief interview & recording consent

Hi Alyssa,

Hope youre well — thanks again for agreeing to help with a short customer spotlight about how Priory Health uses Redwood Inference. Were aiming for a 30-minute discovery interview to capture the story, outcomes, and any measurable impact.

Proposed times (Pacific):
- Tue Nov 24, 10:00–10:30 AM
- Tue Nov 24, 3:00–3:30 PM
- Wed Nov 25, 9:00–9:30 AM

Rough agenda (attached):
- 5 min intros + context
- 15 min outcomes & workflow discussion
- 5 min metrics / ROI highlights
- 5 min follow-up / next steps

We typically record these calls (audio + meeting notes) for internal write-up and with your permission for a short public case study. If youre comfortable, please reply with which time works and whether Priory is okay with the recording and a customer quote. If legal needs to sign anything, loop them in and well work it through.

Attaching a one-page agenda for reference.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
